review.scope: Answer only the author's explicit question about a trustworthy Tool-view key-to-owner mapping for fixed-commit admission; confirm the current manual-review gate and no automatic exemption. Do not address unrelated catalog listing, DSH compatibility, or offer ongoing support.
review.requestQuote: Before adding an exemption, which trusted source should bind a key to its owner at the fixed commit?

responseBody: There is no trusted key-to-owner mapping available to the fixed-commit Catalog scanner today. A key declared by the plugin itself, including a package-name or repository-name prefix, is self-asserted and does not prove ownership. The safe current boundary is to keep every Tool-view registration behind manual scope and key-ownership review. Do not add an automatic exemption until DSH provides a verifiable ownership contract or DSH Store maintains a centrally reviewed mapping from the canonical immutable repository identity to the key, checked against the pinned source commit. So the fail-closed gate in this revision is the right behavior for now.
